common.disclaimer: LesTrace is a data preparation tool. The user is responsible for the due diligence statement.

home.title: EUDR data for the timber industry
home.subtitle: Enter your plots and documents once and get a correct GeoJSON, due diligence statement data and a buyer package for every shipment.
home.deadlineLarge: Large and medium companies: EUDR applies from 30 Dec 2026.
home.deadlineSmall: Micro and small companies: EUDR applies from 30 Jun 2027.

issues.GEOM_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: Geometry type {type} is not allowed. Use a point or a polygon.
issues.COORD_OUT_OF_RANGE: Coordinates are out of range (longitude −180 to 180, latitude −90 to 90).
issues.COORD_SWAPPED: Latitude and longitude seem to be swapped. Check the column order.
issues.COORD_LOOKS_PROJECTED: Coordinates are in metres (e.g. D96/TM), not WGS-84 degrees. Choose the right coordinate system when importing.
issues.PRECISION_TOO_LOW: Coordinates have only {found} decimal places; at least {required} are required.
issues.PRECISION_PARTIAL: Some coordinates have only {found} decimal places (trailing zeros may have been lost). At least {required} are recommended.
issues.POLYGON_CLOSED_AUTOMATICALLY: The polygon was not closed, so we closed it automatically. Check its shape on the map.
issues.POLYGON_TOO_FEW_POINTS: The polygon has too few points (at least 3 distinct points are needed).
issues.POLYGON_SELF_INTERSECTION: The polygon boundary crosses itself (at {lon}, {lat}). Fix the order of the points.
issues.POLYGON_HOLE_OUTSIDE: A hole of the polygon lies outside its outer boundary. Fix the plot outline.
issues.LABEL_POINTS_REMOVED: Label points next to the polygon were removed; only the polygon is used.
issues.RING_ORIENTATION_FIXED: The direction of the polygon outline was fixed automatically.
issues.Z_COORDINATE_REMOVED: Altitude was removed because EUDR does not need it.
issues.POINT_OVER_4HA: The plot has {areaHa} ha. Plots larger than {maxHa} ha must be entered as a polygon.
issues.POINT_POLYGON_RECOMMENDED: The plot is entered as a point. This is allowed, but a polygon is recommended.
issues.POINT_AREA_MISSING: The point has no area. TRACES would assume {defaultHa} ha.
issues.OUTSIDE_COUNTRY: The plot is not in the selected country ({country}).
issues.COUNTRY_CHECK_UNAVAILABLE: We cannot check plot locations for {country} yet.
issues.DUPLICATE_PLOT: The plot is almost identical to an existing plot ({ids}).
issues.AREA_ZERO: The polygon has no area (all points lie on one line).
issues.NO_GEOMETRY: The plot has no geolocation. It can only be used for a simplified declaration, not for a due diligence statement.
issues.CRS_GUESSED: The file does not state its coordinate system. We assume {crs} (Slovenian D96/TM), but it could also be {alternatives} (old D48/GK, ~600 m apart). Please confirm the right system.
issues.CRS_UNKNOWN: The file's coordinate system is unknown. Export the file in WGS-84 (EPSG:4326) or D96/TM (EPSG:3794).
issues.PARSE_FAILED: The file or row could not be read.
issues.EXPORT_TOO_LARGE: The GeoJSON file is too large ({bytes} bytes, max {max}). Split the shipment or simplify the polygons.
